title: Bake Again
description: Turning tested gluten-free recipes into an interactive cooking product through domain knowledge, product direction and AI-assisted development.
subtitle: From tested recipes to guided cooking.
summary: Bake Again grew out of years of gluten-free baking for my family. I wanted to make recipes I’d tested myself useful to others—not only as instructions to read, but as practical guidance while cooking.

role.title: My contribution
role.text: I brought the baking knowledge, defined the product and recipe model, guided the design and reviewed the implementation. AI generated the application code through this iterative collaboration.

decisions.title: Recipes that adapt
decisions.text: Changing a recipe means more than multiplying every ingredient. I shaped a shared model for quantities, components and cooking steps, so one adjustment carries through the recipe and Cook Mode.
decisions.example: At half the base quantity, the recipe calculates 1.5 eggs and flags the amount for the cook to check.

states.title: Suggested
states.text: The proposed change has not been bake-tested.

image.alt: Adjust recipe at half the base quantity, with calculated ingredients and a reminder to check fractional eggs.
image.caption: A half batch recalculates ingredients and flags whole items that need a decision.

decisions.title: Guidance while cooking
decisions.text: I wanted the recipe to remain useful once someone started baking. Cook Mode brings the current instructions, relevant ingredients, photographs and readiness checkpoints into one view.
decisions.example: For the mixing step, the cook can compare the dough with photographs and use a readiness checkpoint to decide when to stop.

image.alt: Cook Mode showing the mixing step, its ingredients, a readiness checkpoint and two preparation photographs.
image.caption: The current step brings instructions, ingredients and visual guidance together.

details.title: Timing follows the process
details.text: The model distinguishes active work from elapsed time and connects preparation, waiting and cooking phases to specific steps. This lets different recipes share a structure while keeping their own sequence and timing.

decisions.title: Help in context
decisions.text: Common questions should be easy to answer without interrupting the cooking task. I separated prepared explanations from custom AI questions, with both grounded in the recipe and current step.

paths.title: Prepared answers
paths.text: I used AI to prepare common questions in advance. Answers come from reviewed text and recipe guidance, adjusted to the selected configuration, without a new model request.

paths.title: Custom AI questions
paths.text: New questions use the recipe version, selected quantities, language and current step as context. Responses are checked against that context; AI cannot mark a recipe as Tested.

decisions.note: The screenshot shows a prepared recipe answer.

image.alt: Full Step questions panel showing a prepared answer, related question and separate field for a custom AI question.
image.caption: Prepared recipe guidance and custom AI questions have distinct places in the interface.

review.title: Direction through review
review.text: During implementation review, I asked to replace browser-import and manual-sync controls with a simpler flow: offer sign-in when someone wants to save a recipe or note.

technical.title: Technical details
technical.text: A shared recipe model supports Ukrainian, English and Spanish. Reader accounts, newsletter consent and product analytics have separate responsibilities.
technical.verification: Data checks, interface review and deterministic assistant evaluations cover the application’s rules and safeguards. Live AI answer quality requires its own evaluation.
technical.controls: Custom AI requests have limits on input size, response length, concurrency and timeouts. A shared quota service reserves a maximum cost before generation; requests are rejected when that service is unavailable. Structured responses and their references are validated against the recipe context.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: Tested gluten-free recipes are now an interactive collection: cooks can adjust quantities, follow each step and get help in context.
